크레인 벨(Crane Bell Co.)은 일본 오사카를 거점으로 자전거: Crane Bell Co. is a bicycle bell maker based in Osaka, Japan. Rooted in Japan's long cycling culture, every bell is made in Japan, with domes formed from two materials, brass and aluminium.
크레인 벨이 알려진 이유는 소리입니다. 한 번 치면 맑고 또렷하게 울리고: Crane is known for its sound. One strike gives a clear, crisp ring that lingers so long it is often compared to a musical instrument. A simple construction built to last and a design that never dates make it at home on anything from a classic build to an everyday city bike.
모든 벨을 일본에서 만드는 벨 전문 브랜드: A bell specialist that makes every bell in Japan
작은 이네 벨부터 큰 리튼 벨까지 네 가지 크기: Four sizes, from the small E-ne to the large Riten
울림이 깊은 황동, 가볍고 변색에 강한 알루미늄: Brass for a deep ring, aluminium for light weight and tarnish resistance
이네 벨 한 모델에서 고르는 마감의 수: Finishes to choose from on the E-ne alone

Outstanding quality, superior sound.
A bell that lasts, a ring that lingers.
크레인 벨은 화려한 기능보다 기본에 집중합니다. 프레스로 성형한 금속 돔: Crane focuses on the basics rather than features. A pressed metal dome, a spring lever under the thumb, a mount that grips the bar firmly. With so few parts there is little to go wrong, and the bell feels more familiar the longer you use it.
같은 모델이라도 마감에 따라 소재가 다릅니다. 크롬, 골드, 코퍼, 네오: The material changes with the finish, even within one model. Chrome, gold, copper and Neo Black finishes are brass, for a deeper and longer ring, while silver and Stealth Black are aluminium and lighter. The easiest rule is to match the metal tone of your bar, stem and brake levers.
황동 돔은 소리가 맑고 오래 이어집니다. 크롬 도금, 골드, 코퍼, 네오: A brass dome rings clear and long. Chrome plated, gold, copper and Neo Black finishes are brass.
실버와 스텔스 블랙은 알루미늄입니다. 같은 이네 벨에서 황동 53g, 알: Silver and Stealth Black are aluminium. On the same E-ne, that means 38g instead of 53g in brass.
스프링이 든 레버를 엄지로 튕겨 칩니다. 장갑을 낀 채로도 쉽게 울리고,: Flick the spring-loaded lever with your thumb. It is easy to ring even in gloves, and the lever springs back on its own.
크롬 플레이트, 폴리시드 · 매트 실버, 골드, 코퍼, 브러시드 코퍼,: Chrome Plated, Polished and Matte Silver, Gold, Copper, Brushed Copper, Brown, Neo Black and Stealth Black, with several finishes for every model.
모델마다 구성이 다르며, 모델별 마감은 마감 가이드에서 확인: Availability varies by model; see the finish guide for each model
벨은 자전거에서 가장 작은 부품이지만, 다른 사람에게 가장 먼저 들리는: The bell is the smallest part on a bicycle, but it is the first part other people hear.
골목에서 앞사람에게 길을 묻듯 알리는 소리는 날카롭지 않아야 하고, 그러: A bell that asks the way past someone in a narrow street should never sound harsh, yet it has to be clear. Crane bells strike that balance well. Ring each model in our showroom and you will hear right away how size and material change the sound.
황동 마감은 쓰면서 표면의 광이 차분하게 바뀌는데, 이것도 자전거와 함께: Brass finishes mellow with use, part of how a bell ages with its bicycle. If you want to keep the original shine longer, choose Chrome Plated or Neo Black; for something lighter and lower maintenance, choose aluminium silver.
The four Crane Bell models carried by Rubi Workshop and Rubi Supply.
크레인 벨의 대표 모델. 작은 37mm 돔에 22.2~31.8mm 핸들바: Crane Bell's signature model. A small 37mm dome, a band that fits 22.2 to 31.8mm bars, 11 finishes.
작은 크기에 크고 맑은 소리를 내는 컴팩트한 레버 벨. 미니벨로와 몰튼에: A compact lever bell with a big, clear ring for its size. A natural fit for minivelos and Moultons.
코일 스프링 스트라이커로 밝게 울리는 45mm 벨. 미니 스즈와 같은 크: A 45mm bell that rings bright with a coil spring striker. Same size as the Mini Suzu, a different voice.
라인업에서 가장 큰 57mm 황동 벨. 크게 울리는 벨을 원하는 클래식: The largest bell in the range, a 57mm brass dome. For classic and touring builds that want a loud ring.
The smallest bell,
the most finishes.
Crane's signature model.
이네 벨(E-ne Bell)은 지름 37mm의 작은 돔으로 핸들바 위에서: The E-ne Bell has a small 37mm dome that almost disappears on the handlebar, yet one strike brings the long, clear ring Crane is known for. A rubber-lined clamp band grips without scratching and fits everything from 22.2mm flat bars to 31.8mm oversized bars.
마감은 크레인 벨 라인업에서 가장 많은 11가지입니다. 크롬, 골드, 코: It comes in 11 finishes, the most in the Crane line: brass finishes such as chrome, gold, copper, brown and Neo Black, aluminium silver and Stealth Black, plus All Chrome Plated and All Stealth Black, where the lever and mount match the dome.
크레인 벨에서 가장 작은 돔입니다. 핸들바 공간이 좁은 로드, 미니벨로,: The smallest dome Crane makes. It sits neatly on road bikes, minivelos and city bikes where bar space is tight.
고무를 덧댄 클램프 밴드 하나로 플랫바부터 31.8mm 핸들바의 중심부까: One rubber-lined clamp band fits everything from flat bars to the 31.8mm center of a handlebar, without leaving marks.
크롬, 골드, 코퍼, 브라운, 네오 블랙 계열은 황동, 실버와 스텔스 블: Chrome, gold, copper, brown and Neo Black finishes are brass; silver and Stealth Black are aluminium. Choose by sound and weight.
올 크롬 플레이트와 올 스텔스 블랙은 레버와 마운트까지 같은 톤으로 맞춰: All Chrome Plated and All Stealth Black carry the same tone through the lever and mount, so the bell reads as one piece.
황동 (실버 · 스텔스 블랙은 알루미늄): Brass (Silver and Stealth Black are aluminium)

미니 스즈 벨(Mini Suzu Bell)과 미니 카렌 벨(Mini Ka: The Mini Suzu Bell and Mini Karen Bell are compact bells with a 45mm dome. Suzu (鈴) is Japanese for bell. The Mini Suzu, a smaller take on Crane's original Suzu, strikes the dome with a curved lever in the classic way, while the Mini Karen rings brighter and lighter with a coil spring striker.
두 모델 모두 다이캐스트 마운트로 22.2mm와 25.4mm 핸들바에 고: Both use a die cast mount for 22.2mm and 25.4mm handlebars, and suit minivelos, Moultons and classic city bikes where bar space is tight. Polished and Matte Silver are aluminium; chrome, gold, copper and Neo Black are brass.
오리지널 스즈 벨을 작게 줄인 45mm 벨입니다. 곡선 레버의 해머가 돔: A 45mm version of the original Suzu bell. The classic curved lever hammer strikes the dome for a ring that is loud and clear for its size, and the large lever is easy to use in gloves.
코일 스프링 스트라이커로 돔을 치는 45mm 벨입니다. 미니 스즈와 같은: A 45mm bell struck by a coil spring striker. The same size as the Mini Suzu, with a brighter, lighter ring and a little less weight. Available in silver, gold, copper and black finishes.

몰튼과 미니벨로는 핸들바가 짧고, 그 위에 시프터와 레버가 촘촘히 자리: Moultons and minivelos have short handlebars crowded with shifters and levers. At 45mm, the Mini Suzu and Mini Karen fit in the gaps and still ring loud enough for the city.
클래식한 모습을 원하면 레버가 보이는 미니 스즈, 더 밝고 경쾌한 소리를: For a classic look with a visible lever, choose the Mini Suzu; for a brighter, livelier ring, the Mini Karen. If your bar is thicker than 25.4mm, go with the 37mm E-ne Bell.

리튼 벨(Riten Bell)은 크레인 벨 라인업에서 가장 큰 57mm: The Riten Bell is the largest bell in the Crane line, a 57mm brass dome. The bigger dome means a louder, longer ring that carries on busy roads and open streets. A medallion stamped with the Crane logo sits at the center of the dome.
스틸 밴드 마운트로 22.2mm와 25.4mm 핸들바에 고정하며, 크롬: A steel band mount fits 22.2mm and 25.4mm handlebars, and it comes in four finishes: Chrome Plated, Gold, Copper and Neo Black. It suits classic road and touring bikes with silver parts, and city bikes with brown leather saddles. The Riten Bell is supplied to dealers through Rubi Supply.

자전거에 맞춰 고르는 벨: Choosing a bell for your bike
벨은 핸들바 위에서 가장 눈에 띄는 작은 부품입니다. 자전거의 금속 톤과: A bell is the most visible small part on the handlebar. Choose the model and finish by your bike's metal tone, your bar diameter and how loud you want it to ring. Here are the four guidelines we use for custom builds at Rubi Workshop.
실버 부품이 많은 클래식 로드 · 투어링 빌드에는 크롬 플레이트나 폴리시: On classic road and touring builds with lots of silver parts, Chrome Plated or Polished Silver looks natural. For a loud ring choose the Riten; for something small and neat, the E-ne.
블랙 부품 위주의 빌드에는 네오 블랙이나 스텔스 블랙이 벨을 튀지 않게: On builds with mostly black parts, Neo Black or Stealth Black keeps the bell from standing out. Neo Black is glossy; Stealth Black is close to matte.
브라운 가죽 안장이나 그립, 바테이프와 함께 골드 · 코퍼 벨을 두면 핸: Paired with a brown leather saddle, grips or bar tape, a gold or copper bell adds a warm accent to the cockpit. The E-ne comes in both polished and matte gold.
핸들바 공간이 좁은 미니벨로나 몰튼에는 45mm 미니 스즈 · 미니 카렌: Minivelos and Moultons with little bar space suit small bells such as the 45mm Mini Suzu and Mini Karen or the 37mm E-ne. Check your bar diameter first.
벨은 직접 울려봐야 압니다. 루비워크샵 쇼룸에서 크레인 벨을 모델과 마감: You have to ring a bell to know it. At the Rubi Workshop showroom you can ring Crane bells by model and finish, and we will help you choose one to suit your handlebar and parts. We also fit them to custom builds and new bikes.
